text: {"lessons":["I should make each trade conditional on a clear thesis and current evidence, not react to short-term price moves or recent account gains and losses.","Before trading, I should check cash needs, position sizes, and concentration across the whole portfolio; selling one holding and buying another should improve the portfolio, not just reshuffle risk.","I should evaluate my results over many periods against the overall market and review whether my decisions followed a disciplined process, rather than treating a short run of returns as proof of skill."]}
